launch_blockers.finding: Current active auth method is not established. Even a ChatGPT result does not establish zero paid-credit consumption. Root current documentation review reports both subscription and paid credits are possible and current usage lookup errors.
launch_blockers.minimal_clearance: Need existing reliable evidence that this one request cannot draw paid credits or create an extra charge. Do not infer this from forced_login_method, provider, API-key exclusion, low reasoning, default service tier or past free smoke. If unavailable, leave NOT RUN; do not change account settings or purchase credits.

launch_blockers.finding: Eight explicit disable flags do not prove all tools unavailable on this binary. Saved feature defaults include computer_use, browser_use, browser_use_external, code_mode_host, unified_exec, view_image and plugins enabled; feature availability does not itself prove registration. Help scopes read-only sandbox to model-generated shell commands. ignore-user-config skips config.toml, not all instructions/skills or credentials.
launch_blockers.minimal_clearance: For this fixed-text smoke, establish that effective tool/config/context surface cannot perform unauthorized host, browser, remote or paid actions; do not use prompt instructions alone as enforcement. A D-only synthetic cwd and read-only flag do not prove broader read isolation. If that cannot be established from available non-model evidence, do not launch.

safe_minimal_authmethod_check.purpose: One local metadata-only active-auth-method check, not a model request and not billing proof.
safe_minimal_authmethod_check.candidate: Pinned executable login status with existing CODEX_HOME and explicitly filtered environment, only after root confirms this version exposes that command.
safe_minimal_authmethod_check.ignore_user_config: Saved help lists --ignore-user-config under exec; do not assume it is accepted by login status. No global equivalent is established by the reviewed evidence. A config parse error is a blocked check, not permission to edit, rename, bypass or substitute configuration.
safe_minimal_authmethod_check.handling: Capture output only in memory; emit only recognized method enum and exit status. Do not save or print raw output because API-key-mode status can disclose a key fragment in some clients. Hash optional, not necessary. Never inspect/copy auth.json or token stores, log in, log out or refresh credentials as a workaround.
safe_minimal_authmethod_check.acceptance: Only clear local ChatGPT/subscription method succeeds at this gate. API-key, external/unknown mode, error or ambiguity means stop. ChatGPT alone leaves BILLING_ROUTE unresolved.
safe_minimal_authmethod_check.limit: This reviewer did not run login status and does not claim it is side-effect/network-free for this exact build.

if_all_blockers_cleared_minimal_executio: Use only new explicit one-test authorization; old smoke permissions are exhausted. Pin reviewed Git source, actual binary hash and exact version freshly.

Single CodexAdapter with contextual_factory=CodexProcessFactory, max_runs=1 and running_limit=1; one fixed inline synthetic prompt, one request, bounded timeout/output, same event loop retained through owned-parent cleanup.

D-only ordinary non-reparse synthetic Git fixture with no remote, no private content or executable hooks; hash fixture before/after. Pass explicit filtered environment; no API keys/provider overrides/remote target or copied credentials.

Record authorization consumption before first possible model start. No retry, fallback, resume or second task after failure/unknown; CLI-internal request behavior is not proven by factory local single-attempt guard.

Accept only terminal adapter result with exact expected fixed reply, zero process error, no unexpected tool activity and unchanged fixture. Do not present parent process exit as server cancellation proof.
